incident_tickets.title: payment-api returning 500 errors — users unable to checkout
incident_tickets.description: Multiple customers reporting checkout failures. payment-api returning HTTP 500. Error logs show SSL handshake timeout. Started approximately 09:05 UTC.

incident_tickets.title: notification-service degraded — downstream timeout in checkout
incident_tickets.description: Notification service responding slowly. DB connection errors in logs. payment-api checkout flow timing out when calling notification-service. Affecting ~8% of transactions.

incident_tickets.title: internal-dashboard login page returns 404
incident_tickets.description: A few users reporting the internal dashboard login page returns 404. Appears intermittent — not all users affected. No monitoring alert triggered.

incident_tickets.title: fraud-check service unreachable from payment-api
incident_tickets.description: payment-api reporting upstream call to fraud-check timing out. No errors in fraud-check logs directly. Possible network partition.
